name: MarkItDown
description: Python library that converts office documents and other files into Markdown for downstream processing.
limitations: The optional OCR plugin sends document images to a configured OpenAI-compatible vision model. Core conversion does not require that plugin.

name: Paperclip
description: Open-source application for assigning, tracking, and reviewing work carried out by software agents.

name: Repomix
description: Command-line tool that packs selected repository files into one text bundle for coding agents.
limitations: Sandbox mode is an application-level path restriction, not an operating-system sandbox.
security_notes: MCP file tools are limited to a workspace directory only when started with --sandbox. Without that flag, pack_codebase trusts repomix.config in the directory it packs.

name: ACE
description: Framework for iterative agent context engineering that updates a playbook from execution feedback.
limitations: This entry is the ace-agent/ace framework. It does not establish the source repository of any particular tutorial screenshot.

name: AgentTrace
description: Local Rust terminal interface that audits coding-agent session logs for cost, tokens, latency, and failures.
limitations: Parser coverage depends on the session format of each coding-agent harness.
security_notes: Session logs can contain prompts and file paths. Keep audit output on the machine that produced the logs.

name: AI Engineering Coach
description: VS Code extension that reads local coding-agent session logs and summarizes usage. It is not an official Microsoft product.
limitations: README disclaimer: community effort by Microsoft employees, not an official Microsoft product or support offering.

name: Crawl4AI
description: Python crawler that turns web pages into Markdown or JSON intended for language-model pipelines.
limitations: Self-hosting needs a browser runtime. The project's hosted cloud service publishes separate free and paid quotas.

name: Humanizer
description: Agent skill that edits text to reduce common signs of machine-generated writing.

name: Impeccable
description: Agent skill that supplies a design vocabulary for coding agents to critique and revise interface work.

name: Taste Skill
description: Agent skills that guide coding agents on visual direction, reference images, and browser-based design review.

name: Agent Research Skills
description: Skill package for systematic academic literature review inside Claude Code and similar coding agents.

name: AgentHatch
description: Tool that wraps an agent skill as a standalone runnable agent with retrieval over supplied documents.

name: Anthropic Cookbook
description: Official collection of notebooks showing concrete ways to call Claude for programming and document tasks.

name: Awesome MCP Servers
description: Curated list of Model Context Protocol servers with links to their source repositories.
limitations: A directory entry is not a review of the linked server's security or maintenance.

name: Awesome Vibe Coding
description: Curated list of articles, tools, and repositories about writing software together with coding agents.

name: Brigade
description: Control-plane application for coordinating a group of agents and their shared task state.
limitations: Listed as a reference control plane. It does not replace an existing task system by itself.

name: Camofox Browser
description: Headless browser aimed at automated agents that need to load sites protected by bot checks.
security_notes: The project describes bypassing bot checks. Use it only on sites whose terms allow automated access, and keep it isolated from credentials.

name: Caveman
description: Coding-agent skill and proxy that shortens prompts so routine tool calls use fewer tokens.
limitations: Token savings are a project claim and were not measured for this catalog entry.

name: Claude Ads
description: Agent skill that drafts and checks paid-media work across several advertising platforms from Claude Code.
limitations: Advertising accounts, spend, and platform terms sit outside the skill package.

name: Claude Code Settings
description: Templates for Claude Code skills, sub-agents, and configuration used in research and engineering tasks.

name: Claude Task Master
description: Task-management system that breaks a feature request into tracked tasks for coding-agent editors.

name: CLI Anything
description: Project that generates command-line interfaces so existing software can be driven by coding agents.

name: Colibri
description: C inference engine that runs mixture-of-experts language models from local storage without extra dependencies.
limitations: Hardware requirements and model licenses were not measured for this catalog entry.

name: Context Engineering Intro
description: Introductory repository on structuring context so coding agents can follow a software task.

name: Dify
description: Application for building agent workflows and retrieval pipelines with a visual editor and model connectors.

name: Firecrawl
description: Web data API and crawler that extracts page content for agent and retrieval workflows.
limitations: Hosted crawling has its own quota and terms. Self-hosting is a separate deployment.

name: FreeLLMAPI
description: Gateway that exposes many third-party language-model endpoints through one interface, including unpaid tiers.
limitations: Unpaid provider quotas, uptime, and data handling are properties of those providers, not of this catalog entry.
security_notes: Prompts and API keys are sent to the selected third-party model provider. Retention and logging follow that provider.

name: GameDev Agent Skills
description: Collection of game-development skills for coding agents covering several game engines and libraries.

name: GitDiagram
description: Web application that draws an interactive architecture diagram from a public GitHub repository.

name: Gstack
description: Opinionated Claude Code skill pack for planning, design review, and shipping software changes.

name: Huashu Design
description: Agent skill that turns a short design prompt into web, app, slide, or infographic drafts.

name: Hyper Marketing Skills
description: Small collection of marketing skills for agents covering ads, social posts, search, and competitor notes.

name: Hyperframes
description: Renderer that turns HTML documents into video files and is documented for use by agents.
limitations: Render, asset, and model costs are separate from the repository license.

name: Knowledge Work Plugins
description: Official plugin collection for knowledge-work tasks inside Claude, published by Anthropic in this repository.
limitations: Individual plugin licenses can differ from the repository root. Check each plugin before reuse.

name: Magnitude
description: Local inference engine that searches kernel settings on the host machine to speed model execution.
limitations: Hardware requirements and model licenses were not measured for this catalog entry.

name: Magpie
description: Menu-bar gateway that routes coding-agent clients to one selected language-model provider endpoint.
security_notes: Prompts and API keys are sent to the selected third-party model provider. Retention and logging follow that provider.

name: Maxun
description: Web extraction application that turns site pages into structured records and repeatable monitors.

name: Oh My OpenAgent
description: Coding-agent harness that routes a prompt through a graph of specialized agent roles.

name: OmniRoute
description: Gateway that exposes many language-model providers, including unpaid endpoints, through one API.
limitations: Unpaid provider quotas are set by those providers and were not rechecked as a live entitlement.
security_notes: Prompts and API keys are sent to the selected third-party model provider. Retention and logging follow that provider.

name: OpenAI Cookbook
description: Official notebooks and guides that show how to call the OpenAI API for application tasks.

name: OpenAI Evals
description: Official framework and open registry for evaluating language models and model-based systems.

name: OpenMontage
description: Agent-oriented video production system that chains planning, asset, and render steps in pipelines.
limitations: Model, asset, and render costs are separate from the repository license and were not measured here.

name: Remotion Skills
description: Agent skills that help coding agents author videos with the Remotion React renderer.

name: Turbovec
description: Rust vector index with Python bindings, built on TurboQuant, for similarity search over embeddings.
limitations: This is a vector index. It is not an agent runtime or a memory service.

name: UI UX Pro Max
description: Agent skill that suggests interface patterns and design tokens for multi-platform user interfaces.

name: Vibe Coding Prompt Template
description: Prompt templates that ask a language model for a product brief, technical design, and a small first version.

name: Academic Research Skills
description: Skill set for coding agents that sequences academic research, drafting, review, and revision.

name: Open Notebook
description: Open-source notebook application for chatting with documents, using a NotebookLM-style research workflow.
limitations: Screenshot attribution to this repository was not uniquely proven. The entry follows the GitHub project description.
